channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: ‘Loved by everybody’: Friends and neighbors recall the lives of 3 women killed in Wayne County
item.description: Pink ribbons are fluttering in Wayne County’s small towns as mourners leave flowers at a trailhead memorial for Margaret Oldroyd, Linda Dewey and Natalie Graves.

item.title: Letter: The real reason for most of America’s wars is avoiding regime change at home
item.description: Letter: Why did Trump attack Iran? To divert attention from his sinking poll numbers and the increasingly dire Epstein files revelations.

item.title: Letter: PacifiCorp’s divestment decision is bound to spur higher energy prices and environmental degradation
item.description: Letter: PacifiCorp’s divestment decision will result in higher energy costs and worse air quality. Our elected leaders don’t care.

item.title: Letter: Utah’s low unemployment rate and productivity are something to celebrate. But the toll on workers needs more attention.
item.description: Letter: A resilient workforce requires more than endurance. It requires room for human limits. Slowing down should not mean falling out of the circle of contribution.

item.title: Swanky condos with eye-popping price tags take over historic SLC building. Take a look inside.
item.description: The 114-year-old building is home to new luxury units listed at north of a million bucks.

item.title: Utah prosecutor will seek death penalty if Iowa man accused of killing 3 women in Wayne County is convicted
item.description: After an offer of help, Wayne County's prosecutor has decided he will seek the death penalty if Ivan Miller is convicted of killing three women in southern Utah.

item.title: Gov. Cox rushes to sign final-hour GOP bid to sink Prop 4 signature removal efforts
item.description: Gov. Cox signed a bill early Saturday morning targeting Better Boundaries' effort asking Utahns to remove their signature from an initiative that seeks to end Utahs gerrymandering ban.

item.title: Utah Legislature cuts income taxes, targets courts and kills controversial bills during 2026 session
item.description: Here's how the 541 bills the Legislature passed in 2026 will impact Utahns' lives.

item.title: Quarterback Tyler Huntley returning to Ravens on two-year deal
item.description: Former University of Utah quarterback Tyler Huntley is returning to the Baltimore Ravens on a two-year, $5 million deal to back up Lamar Jackson.

item.title: Real Salt Lake wards off winless Atlanta United FC for 3-2 victory
item.description: Real Salt Lake holds off Atlanta United FC, 3-2, for its second straight victory.
